Final pick of anchor pixels among the candidates

Source: R/metric-anchors.R
ef_anchor_pick.Rd

Defines how the anchor pixels of one class are picked among the candidates that passed the rules and the homogeneity test: a fraction of the coldest (or hottest) candidates, or a fixed number of them.

Usage

ef_anchor_pick(variable, method, value)

Arguments

variable

Character. Layer used to rank the candidates: "lst", "ndvi", "albedo" or "lai" (usually "lst").

method

Character. One of:

  • "lowest_fraction": candidates with variable <= Q(value), the quantile of the candidates at probability value;

  • "highest_fraction": candidates with variable >= Q(1 - value);

  • "lowest": the value candidates with the lowest variable;

  • "highest": the value candidates with the highest variable.

value

Numeric. A fraction in (0, 1] for the *_fraction methods, a whole number >= 1 for "lowest" and "highest".

Value

A list of class earthflux_anchor_pick with elements variable, method and value.

Details

The pick is deterministic. The *_fraction methods keep every candidate equal to the threshold. "lowest" and "highest" order the candidates by variable and then by ascending cell number (row by row from the top left corner); when equal values straddle the limit, the tie is resolved by cell number and the anchor set is flagged with EF_ANCHOR_TIES.

Verification status: the fractions of 0.2 observed in water are CANDIDATA; no value is a default here.

See also

Other anchor pixel functions: ef_anchor_conditions(), ef_anchor_criteria(), ef_anchor_rule(), ef_anchors(), ef_homogeneity(), ef_select_anchors()

Examples

# The coldest 20 % of the cold candidates
ef_anchor_pick("lst", "lowest_fraction", 0.2)
#> $variable
#> [1] "lst"
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] "lowest_fraction"
#> 
#> $value
#> [1] 0.2
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "earthflux_anchor_pick" "list"                 

# The single hottest hot candidate
ef_anchor_pick("lst", "highest", 1)
#> $variable
#> [1] "lst"
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] "highest"
#> 
#> $value
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "earthflux_anchor_pick" "list"
